decks.notes: This UR Aggro deck focuses on quick and aggressive play, utilizing cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler to put pressure on the opponent. Cards like Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge help to pump up creatures for faster damage output, while Slickshot Show-Off provides additional value. Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart provide removal and direct damage, allowing the deck to maintain momentum. The deck's mana base is optimized to support its aggressive strategy, allowing for efficient casting of spells and creatures to push for a fast victory.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End. It also includes control elements like Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return to disrupt opponents' strategies. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with large creatures and board control, utilizing cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Herigast, Erupting Nullkite. The goal is to quickly ramp up mana, control the board, and deploy massive threats to dominate the game.

This deck focuses on a combination of aggressive creatures and cards that allow for repetitive blinking (exiling and returning) of those creatures for additional value. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, the deck can repeatedly trigger powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities to control the board and apply pressure to the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and value-generating interactions.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through hand disruption and removal spells, while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures. It also utilizes flicker effects to gain value from enters-the-battlefield triggers and protect key creatures. The deck aims to control the board and outvalue opponents with its synergy between creatures and spells. Additionally, it has a slight graveyard hate subtheme with Relic of Progenitus. Overall, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot by disrupting their resources and applying pressure with efficient threats.

The main aim of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through a combination of counterspells, removal, and hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize. By controlling the board with cards like Fatal Push and Harbinger of the Seas, while also utilizing graveyard recursion with Unearth and Thought Scour, the deck aims to out-value the opponent and win through attrition. The deck also incorporates threats like Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted.

The deck focuses on using Eldrazi creatures to control the game and ramp up to play powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also includes various control spells like Kozilek's Command and Kozilek's Return to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck utilizes mana ramp cards like Utopia Sprawl and Talisman of Impulse to accelerate the casting of its high-cost spells. Overall, the strategy revolves around establishing board control, ramping up mana quickly, and closing out the game with powerful Eldrazi threats.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle while utilizing the blink mechanic to generate value and disrupt opponents' strategies. By combining efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Prismatic Ending with creatures that have powerful enter-the-battlefield triggers such as Flickerwisp and Ketramose, the New Dawn, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents while gaining card advantage. Thoughtseize provides disruption and control, while relics like Relic of Progenitus help to disrupt graveyard strategies. The deck includes a mix of creatures for different situations, ranging from aggressive beaters like Emperor of Bones to versatile utility creatures like Solitude and Psychic Frog. Land base is optimized for consistency and flexibility.

The main concept of this combo landless deck is to disrupt your opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal while ramping up mana with Lotus Bloom and Tameshi, Reality Architect. Once you have enough mana, you can use cards like Whir of Invention to tutor for key combo pieces like Thundertrap Trainer or Goblin Charbelcher to quickly finish off your opponent. By controlling the game and ramping up mana efficiently, this deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and win the game before the opponent can recover.

This deck revolves around using cards like Ardent Plea, Street Wraith, and Living End to cycle through your deck and manipulate the graveyard, eventually casting Living End to bring back all of your powerful creatures and overwhelm your opponent. By using cards like Force of Negation and Generous Ent to protect your game plan, and utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Curator of Mysteries to generate card advantage, you can quickly assemble your combo and close out the game in spectacular fashion.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with disruption and removal spells, while also putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures. The deck also utilizes creatures with abilities that can disrupt the opponent's resources, making it difficult for the opponent to execute their game plan effectively. Additionally, the deck has a strong mana base to ensure that it can consistently cast its spells and creatures. Overall, the deck aims to control the game through disruption and aggression to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on disrupting opponents with a mix of counterspells, removal, and hand disruption while generating card advantage through efficient card draw. It includes a combination of low-cost threats and powerful finishers to control the game and ultimately win through attrition. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while steadily building up its own resources to maintain control of the battlefield and ultimately emerge victorious.

The deck focuses on aggressively deploying creatures like Flameblade Adept, Marauding Mako, and Vengevine, while utilizing cards like Burning Inquiry and Goblin Lore to quickly fill up the graveyard and enable the casting of Hollow One for free or at a reduced cost. Detective's Phoenix and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury add additional threats to the board, while Faithless Looting and Ox of Agonas help with card filtering and graveyard recursion. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast creatures and powerful synergies for a swift victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Ragavan and Guide of Souls to pressure the opponent. It also includes powerful spells like Phlage and Galvanic Discharge to deal damage efficiently. The deck is complemented by control elements like Static Prison and Thraben Charm to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah provides versatility and resilience, while Arena of Glory helps maintain board presence. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to maintain a fast and aggressive pace while still having answers to control the game when needed.

The main idea of this deck is to utilize low-cost aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, along with cheap burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart, to put pressure on the opponent quickly. The deck also includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to help with card selection and maintain momentum. The key strategy is to consistently deal damage to opponents and control the board with a mix of direct damage and creature threats. The deck aims to win the game quickly before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart to swiftly deal damage to the opponent. Cards like Mutagenic Growth and Violent Urge help pump up creatures for extra damage while Slickshot Show-Off provides card advantage. The mana base is optimized for quick and efficient plays, with Mishra's Bauble and Preordain helping to filter draws. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast and efficient aggression, while maintaining some versatility with its card choices.

This deck focuses on assembling the Allosaurus Combo, using cards like Neoform and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for key pieces like Allosaurus Rider and Chancellor of the Tangle. By ramping into big creatures like Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant and casting spells like Birthing Ritual, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and generate a win condition. Additionally, cards like Glittering Wish and Eladamri's Call provide additional utility and flexibility to the deck, making it more versatile in various matchups.
